senses.sense_definition: A gathering or party where people engage in unrestrained group sexual activity.

examples.text: The secret party eventually turned into a wild <w>orgy</w> that lasted until morning.
Tabloid newspapers published rumors that several celebrities were present at the <w>orgy</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An excessive, unrestrained period of indulging in a specific activity, often involving violence, spending, or consumption.

examples.text: The holiday sales event sparked an <w>orgy</w> of consumer spending across the nation.
The invaders swept through the city in an <w>orgy</w> of destruction and violence.

senses.sense_definition: An ancient religious rite or ceremony characterized by wild dancing, drunkenness, and sexual license, held in honor of certain pagan deities.

examples.text: Ancient worshippers gathered at night to celebrate an <w>orgy</w> dedicated to the god Bacchus.
The historian described how each secret <w>orgy</w> involved frenzied dancing and heavy drinking.

traits.comment: Used in historical or mythological contexts describing ancient rites.
